stories.title: Customer toilets coming to Eastgate Square Chester after shoppers called for facilities
stories.summary: Customer toilets are returning to Eastgate Square in Chester, with work under way to install facilities on the first floor of the unit that previously housed Topshop. stories.title: Mold to host Tour of Britain Women stage for first time

stories.title: More than 1,150 children take part in triathlon day at Mold Leisure Centre with Alistair Brownlee
stories.summary: More than 1,150 children from schools across North Wales took part in a triathlon event at Gwella’s Mold Leisure Centre on Tuesday, with Olympic champion Alistair Brownlee attending to meet pupils and present finisher medals. stories.title: Wales survey: one in two ten and eleven year olds on social media each week
stories.summary: Half of ten and eleven year olds in Wales are using social media regularly, according to the largest survey of primary school children’s health and wellbeing ever carried out in the country.
